title: Firefox profile folders
whyItMatters: Firefox keeps one folder per profile for browsing history, cookies, saved logins and form data. The set of profiles and their names shows who used the browser and for what.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: Each profile folder is named <random>.default, <random>.default-release or a user-chosen name. Crash Reports and other non-profile folders live next to Profiles, not inside it.
